records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: As further described in the results of operations, our net sales have significantly increased due to unprecedented customer demand across all major product categories, channels, and geographic regions.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Comparable store sales for the first quarter of fiscal 2021 were $2.71 billion, a 38.6% increase as compared to the first quarter of fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: We usually experience our highest inventory and accounts payable balances during our first fiscal quarter for purchases of seasonal products to support the higher sales volume of the spring selling season, and again during our third fiscal quarter to support the higher sales volume of the cold-weather selling season.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: As a percent of net sales, gross margin in the first quarter of fiscal 2021 increased 148 basis points to 35.2% from 33.8% in the first quarter of fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Operating income for the first quarter of fiscal 2021 increased 104.9% to $230.5 million compared to $112.5 million in the first quarter of fiscal 2020.
